Name: Lawn Grass
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[u][size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size][/u]

This mod lets you plant grass as lawns that grow gradually instead of immediately tall grass that disappears when cut.

By default, with this mod, planting grass starter creates a lawn patch, which is technically grass with 0 grass pieces. To place an ordinary tall grass instead, hold down the mod key (default Left Control). You can swap this behaviour in the config.

Lawn grass grows slowly by default;  lawn growth is limited to one grass piece per day, with a 50% chance of not growing at all. You can change this in the config (vanilla grass grows up to 4 pieces per day).

This mod protects all grass-starter grass from removal (both lawn grass and ordinary tall grass). Instead, once grass is completely cut, it leaves a seasonally-coloured patch of lawn. You can disable protecting non-lawn grass in the config. 

To remove a protected grass object, use a pickaxe on it - this will return a grass starter if the grass was placed as a lawn (you can disable returning grass starter in the config).

The mod also shows visual height difference depending on how many pieces of grass are in each grass object (one grass object can have 0 - 4 grass pieces). So, grass with one grass piece is very short, whereas grass with four grass pieces is full height.

Lawns do not trigger a speed debuff like full-sized grass does. Grass speed debuff with this mod is dependent on grass height (-0.25 per grass piece).

This mod doesn't affect blue grass or other non-grass-starter-type grasses.


[u][size=5][b]Advanced[/b][/size][/u]

The config has an option to treat all grass-starter type grass as lawn grass (disabled by default). If you enable this then disable it later, all non-lawn grass will revert to ordinary behaviour.

If you want to override the lawn sprites, you can use Content Patcher and target the following paths:

[b]aedenthorn.LawnGrass/lawn_spring[/b]
[b]aedenthorn.LawnGrass/lawn_summer[/b]
[b]aedenthorn.LawnGrass/lawn_fall[/b]
[b]aedenthorn.LawnGrass/lawn_winter[/b]

Sprite files are in the mod's assets folder.


[u][size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
